summary: Focused verification of 3 items on TyreBook (AsyncStorage fallback auth, owner@test.com). ALL 3 ITEMS PASSED. (1) All 7 inventory categories render without runtime/page errors and show 'No tyres yet' empty state. (2) Tapping category-add-tyre from /inventory/car routes to /inventory/tyre-form?category=car; filling Brand=Apollo, Model=Amazer, Size=175/70 R13, Purchase=2200, Selling=3000, Stock=6, Rack=B2 and tapping tyre-save-btn returns to /inventory/car with the new row visible. (3) Row shows title 'Apollo · Amazer', size '175/70 R13', meta 'Buy ₹2,200 · Sell ₹3,000 · Rack B2', Qty=6, no LOW badge (6>3).
